page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-96 is a memory-configured server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 756.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It does not feature any graphics processing units and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of nearly 1:8, the c4d-highmem-96 is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity without the need for local physical storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance for these enterprise workloads.
